evals.prompt: Write this benchmark study up as a journal-style scientific paper in IMRAD structure — introduction, methods, results and discussion — so our reviewers can reproduce the numbers.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Produces Introduction, Methods, Results and Discussion sections in that order; Keeps interpretation out of Results and puts it in Discussion; Makes Methods detailed enough to reproduce, with sources, criteria and settings; Ends with a numbered reference list and a one-sentence answer to the opening question.
expectations: Produces Introduction, Methods, Results and Discussion sections in that order
Keeps interpretation out of Results and puts it in Discussion
Makes Methods detailed enough to reproduce, with sources, criteria and settings
Ends with a numbered reference list and a one-sentence answer to the opening question

evals.prompt: My draft mixes the results with my own conclusions and there is no methods section at all — a reviewer said the findings cannot be checked. How should the report be structured so the evidence stands apart from the interpretation?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Separates observations from interpretation into distinct sections; Requires a reproducible methods section and inline citations for external numbers; Includes null findings and excluded cases in the results.
expectations: Separates observations from interpretation into distinct sections
Requires a reproducible methods section and inline citations for external numbers
Includes null findings and excluded cases in the results

evals.prompt: We ran an eight-week experiment and now need an academic whitepaper for external publication — a journal-style write-up of the methods and results that would survive peer review.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Uses the four-section research-report convention with an optional executive summary; States the question, the gap and the objective up front without reporting results there; States limitations and labels any post-hoc hypothesis.
expectations: Uses the four-section research-report convention with an optional executive summary
States the question, the gap and the objective up front without reporting results there
States limitations and labels any post-hoc hypothesis

evals.prompt: Give me a one-page brief for Thursday's board meeting on the supplier situation — the situation, the background, and what should be done about it.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Produces a short decision-oriented brief with a recommendation, not a research report; Does not impose a methods-and-results academic structure.
expectations: Produces a short decision-oriented brief with a recommendation, not a research report
Does not impose a methods-and-results academic structure

evals.prompt: Do a comprehensive, reproducible review of the published literature on this intervention with screening counts and inclusion criteria at each stage.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Runs a PRISMA-style identification, screening, eligibility and inclusion process; Reports the audit trail of included and excluded studies rather than formatting a manuscript.
expectations: Runs a PRISMA-style identification, screening, eligibility and inclusion process
Reports the audit trail of included and excluded studies rather than formatting a manuscript
